ability-urge.name: Ability Urge
ability-urge.effect: Forcibly activates a friendly Pokémon’s ability.
ability-urge.flavorText: When used, it activates the Ability of an ally Pokémon.

absorb-bulb.name: Absorb Bulb
absorb-bulb.effect: Held: Raises the holder’s Special Attack by one stage when it takes Water-type damage.
absorb-bulb.flavorText: A consumable bulb. If the holder is hit by a Water-type move, its Sp. Atk will rise.

adamant-orb.name: Adamant Orb
adamant-orb.effect: Boosts the damage from Dialga’s Dragon-type and Steel-type moves by 20%.
adamant-orb.flavorText: A brightly gleaming orb to be held by Dialga. It boosts the power of Dragon-​ and Steel-type moves.

aguav-berry.name: Aguav Berry
aguav-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to restore 1/8 max HP. Confuses Pokémon that dislike bitter flavor.
aguav-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it restores the user’s HP in a pinch, but will cause confusion if it hates the taste.

air-balloon.name: Air Balloon
air-balloon.effect: Held: Grants immunity to Ground-type moves, Spikes, and Toxic Spikes. Consumed when the holder takes damage from a move.
air-balloon.flavorText: When held by a Pokémon, the Pokémon will float into the air. When the holder is attacked, this item will burst.

amulet-coin.name: Amulet Coin
amulet-coin.effect: Held: Doubles the money earned from a battle. Does not stack with Luck Incense.
amulet-coin.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles a battle’s prize money if the holding Pokémon joins in.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.flavorText: A spray-type medicine. It lifts the effect of poison from one Pokémon.

apicot-berry.name: Apicot Berry
apicot-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/4 max HP to boost Special Defense.
apicot-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Sp. Def stat in a pinch.

apricorn-box.name: Apricorn Box
apricorn-box.flavorText: A handy box where you can store up to 99 Apricorns of each kind.

armor-fossil.name: Armor Fossil
armor-fossil.effect: Can be revived into a Shieldon.
armor-fossil.flavorText: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that lived on the land. It appears to be part of a collar.

aspear-berry.name: Aspear Berry
aspear-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when frozen to cure frozen.
aspear-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it defrosts it.

awakening.name: Awakening
awakening.flavorText: A spray-type medicine. It awakens a Pokémon from the clutches of sleep.

azure-flute.name: Azure Flute
azure-flute.effect: Allows entry into the Hall of Origin. Unreleased.
azure-flute.flavorText: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. It is unknown who made it.

babiri-berry.name: Babiri Berry
babiri-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Steel-type attack to halve the damage.
babiri-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Steel-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

balm-mushroom.name: Balm Mushroom
balm-mushroom.effect: Sell to Hungry Maid for 25000 Pokédollars.
balm-mushroom.flavorText: A rare mushroom which gives off a nice fragrance. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

basement-key.name: Basement Key
basement-key.effect: HS: Key to the tunnel under Goldenrod City. Gen III: Key to New Mauville.
basement-key.flavorText: A key that opens a door in the Goldenrod Tunnel.

belue-berry.name: Belue Berry
belue-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
belue-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

berry-juice.name: Berry Juice
berry-juice.flavorText: A 100% pure juice made of Berries. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.

berry-pots.name: Berry Pots
berry-pots.flavorText: Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever you go.

bicycle.name: Bicycle
bicycle.flavorText: A folding Bicycle that enables much faster movement than the Running Shoes.

big-mushroom.name: Big Mushroom
big-mushroom.effect: Fire Red and Leaf Green: Trade for prior Level-up moves. Sell for 2500 Pokédollars, or to Hungry Maid for 5000 Pokédollars.
big-mushroom.flavorText: A large and rare mushroom. It is sought after by collectors.

big-nugget.name: Big Nugget
big-nugget.effect: Sell to Ore Collector for 30000 Pokédollars.
big-nugget.flavorText: A big nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

big-pearl.name: Big Pearl
big-pearl.effect: Sell for 3750 Pokédollars, or to Ore Collector for 7500 Pokédollars.
big-pearl.flavorText: A quite-large pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

big-root.name: Big Root
big-root.effect: Held: Increases HP recovered from draining moves, Ingrain, and Aqua Ring by 3/10 (30%).
big-root.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that boosts the power of HP-stealing moves to let the holder recover more HP.

binding-band.name: Binding Band
binding-band.effect: Held: Doubles the per-turn damage of multi-turn trapping moves.
binding-band.flavorText: A band that increases the power of binding moves when held.

black-apricorn.name: Black Apricorn
black-apricorn.effect: Used to make a Heavy Ball.
black-apricorn.flavorText: A black Apricorn It has an indescribable scent.

black-belt.name: Black Belt
black-belt.effect: Held: Fighting-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
black-belt.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a belt that boosts determination and Fighting-type moves.

black-flute.name: Black Flute
black-flute.effect: Halves the wild Pokémon encounter rate.
black-flute.flavorText: A toy flute made from black glass. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

black-glasses.name: Black Glasses
black-glasses.effect: Held: Dark-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
black-glasses.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a shady-looking pair of glasses that boosts Dark-type moves.

black-sludge.name: Black Sludge
black-sludge.effect: Held: Poison-type holder recovers 1/16 (6.25%) max HP each turn. Non-Poison-Types take 1/8 (12.5%) max HP damage.
black-sludge.flavorText: A held item that gradually restores the HP of Poison-type Pokémon. It inflicts damage on all other types.

blue-apricorn.name: Blue Apricorn
blue-apricorn.effect: Used to make a Lure Ball.
blue-apricorn.flavorText: A blue Apricorn. It smells a bit like grass.

blue-card.name: Blue Card
blue-card.effect: Keeps track of points from Buena’s show.
blue-card.flavorText: A card to save points for the Buena’s Password show.

blue-flute.name: Blue Flute
blue-flute.flavorText: A toy flute made from blue glass. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

blue-orb.name: Blue Orb
blue-orb.effect: Summons Kyogre to the Embedded Tower.
blue-orb.flavorText: A shiny blue orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.

blue-scarf.name: Blue Scarf
blue-scarf.effect: Raises the holder’s Beauty while in a contest.
blue-scarf.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the Beauty aspect of the holder in a Contest.

blue-shard.name: Blue Shard
blue-shard.effect: No effect. Can be traded for items or moves.
blue-shard.flavorText: A small blue shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.

bluk-berry.name: Bluk Berry
bluk-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
bluk-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

bridge-mail-d.name: Bridge Mail D
bridge-mail-d.effect: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.
bridge-mail-d.flavorText: Stationery featuring a print of a red drawbridge. Let a Pokémon hold it for use.

bridge-mail-m.name: Bridge Mail M
bridge-mail-m.effect: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.
bridge-mail-m.flavorText: Stationery featuring a print of an arched bridge. Let a Pokémon hold it for use.

bridge-mail-s.name: Bridge Mail S
bridge-mail-s.effect: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.
bridge-mail-s.flavorText: Stationery featuring a print of a sky-piercing bridge. Let a Pokémon hold it for use.

bridge-mail-t.name: Bridge Mail T
bridge-mail-t.effect: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.
bridge-mail-t.flavorText: Stationery featuring a print of a steel suspension bridge. Let a Pokémon hold it for use.

bridge-mail-v.name: Bridge Mail V
bridge-mail-v.effect: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.
bridge-mail-v.flavorText: Stationery featuring a print of a brick bridge. Let a Pokémon hold it for use.

bright-powder.name: Bright Powder
bright-powder.effect: Held: Increases the holder’s evasion by 1/9 (11 1/9%).
bright-powder.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It casts a tricky glare that lowers the opponent’s accuracy.

bug-gem.name: Bug Gem
bug-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Bug-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
bug-gem.flavorText: A gem with an insect-like essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Bug-type move only once.

burn-drive.name: Burn Drive
burn-drive.effect: Grants Genesect a red, Fire-type Techno Blast.
burn-drive.flavorText: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Techno Blast to a Fire-type move.

burn-heal.name: Burn Heal
burn-heal.flavorText: A spray-type medicine. It heals a single Pokémon that is suffering from a burn.

calcium.name: Calcium
calcium.effect: Raises Special Attack effort and happiness.
calcium.flavorText: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Sp. Atk (Special Attack) stat of a single Pokémon.

carbos.name: Carbos
carbos.flavorText: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Speed stat of a single Pokémon.

card-key.name: Card Key
card-key.effect: HS: Opens doors in the Radio Tower. Gen III: Unlocks Silph Co Doors.
card-key.flavorText: A card key that opens a shutter in the Radio Tower.

casteliacone.name: Casteliacone
casteliacone.effect: Cures any status ailment and confusion.
casteliacone.flavorText: Castelia City’s specialty, soft-serve ice cream. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

cell-battery.name: Cell Battery
cell-battery.effect: Held: Raises the holder’s Attack by one stage when it takes Electric-type damage.
cell-battery.flavorText: A consumable battery. If the holder is hit by an Electric-type move, its Attack will rise.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.effect: Held: Fire-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
charcoal.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a combustible fuel that boosts the power of Fire-type moves.

charti-berry.name: Charti Berry
charti-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Rock-type attack to halve the damage.
charti-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Rock-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

cheri-berry.name: Cheri Berry
cheri-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when paralyzed to cure paralysis.
cheri-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it recovers from paralysis.

cherish-ball.name: Cherish Ball
cherish-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.
cherish-ball.flavorText: A quite rare Poké Ball that has been specially crafted to commemorate an occasion of some sort.

chesto-berry.name: Chesto Berry
chesto-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when asleep to cure sleep.
chesto-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it recovers from sleep.

chilan-berry.name: Chilan Berry
chilan-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a Normal-type attack to halve the damage.
chilan-berry.flavorText: Weakens a Normal-type attack against the Pokémon holding this berry.

chill-drive.name: Chill Drive
chill-drive.effect: Grants Genesect a white, Ice-type Techno Blast.
chill-drive.flavorText: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Techno Blast to an Ice-type move.

choice-band.name: Choice Band
choice-band.effect: Held: Increases Attack by 50%, but restricts the holder to only one move.
choice-band.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This headband ups Attack, but allows the use of only one of its moves.

choice-scarf.name: Choice Scarf
choice-scarf.effect: Held: Increases Speed by 50%, but restricts the holder to only one move.
choice-scarf.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This scarf boosts Speed, but allows the use of only one of its moves.

choice-specs.name: Choice Specs
choice-specs.effect: Held: Increases Special Attack by 50%, but restricts the holder to only one move.
choice-specs.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These distinctive glasses boost Sp. Atk but allow the use of only one of its moves.

chople-berry.name: Chople Berry
chople-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Fighting-type attack to halve the damage.
chople-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Fighting-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

claw-fossil.name: Claw Fossil
claw-fossil.effect: Can be revived into an Anorith.
claw-fossil.flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It appears to be part of a claw.

cleanse-tag.name: Cleanse Tag
cleanse-tag.effect: Prevents wild encounters of level lower than your party’s lead Pokémon.
cleanse-tag.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the first one in the party.

clear-bell.name: Clear Bell
clear-bell.effect: HS: Allows Kimono-girls to summon Ho-oh. C: Summons Suicune to the Tin Tower.
clear-bell.flavorText: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing.

clever-wing.name: Clever Feather
clever-wing.flavorText: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Sp. Def stat of a single Pokémon.

coba-berry.name: Coba Berry
coba-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Flying-type attack to halve the damage.
coba-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Flying-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

coin-case.name: Coin Case
coin-case.effect: Holds coins for the Game Corner.
coin-case.flavorText: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 50,000 coins.

colbur-berry.name: Colbur Berry
colbur-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Dark-type attack to halve the damage.
colbur-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Dark-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

comet-shard.name: Comet Shard
comet-shard.effect: Sell to Ore Collector for 60000 Pokédollars.
comet-shard.flavorText: A shard which fell to the ground when a comet approached. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

contest-pass.name: Contest Pass
contest-pass.flavorText: The pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on it.

cornn-berry.name: Cornn Berry
cornn-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
cornn-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

coupon-1.name: Coupon 1
coupon-1.effect: The first of three tickets used to obtain a Pokétch.
coupon-1.flavorText: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.

coupon-2.name: Coupon 2
coupon-2.effect: The second of three tickets used to obtain a Pokétch.
coupon-2.flavorText: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.

coupon-3.name: Coupon 3
coupon-3.effect: The last of three tickets used to obtain a Pokétch.
coupon-3.flavorText: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.

cover-fossil.name: Cover Fossil
cover-fossil.effect: Can be revived into a Tirtouga.
cover-fossil.flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea in ancient times. It appears to be part of its back.

custap-berry.name: Custap Berry
custap-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/4 max HP when using a move to go first.
custap-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it gets to move first just once in a pinch.

damp-mulch.name: Damp Mulch
damp-mulch.effect: Growing time of berries is increased, but the soil dries out slower.
damp-mulch.flavorText: A fertilizer to be spread on soft soil in regions where Berries are grown. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

damp-rock.name: Damp Rock
damp-rock.effect: Held: Rain Dance by the holder lasts 8 rounds instead of 5.
damp-rock.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Rain Dance used by the holder.

dark-gem.name: Dark Gem
dark-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Dark-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
dark-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of darkness. When held, it strengthens the power of a Dark-type move only once.

dark-stone.name: Dark Stone
dark-stone.effect: Summons Zekrom for the final battle against N.
dark-stone.flavorText: Zekrom’s body was destroyed and changed into this stone. It is said to be waiting for the emergence of a hero.

data-card-01.name: Data Card 01
data-card-01.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first place overall in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-01.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many victories you’ve had.

data-card-02.name: Data Card 02
data-card-02.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in last place overall in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-02.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many losses you’ve had.

data-card-03.name: Data Card 03
data-card-03.effect: Records the number of times the trainer’s Pokémon have dashed in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-03.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have dashed.

data-card-04.name: Data Card 04
data-card-04.effect: Records the number of times the trainer’s Pokémon have jumped in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-04.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have jumped.

data-card-05.name: Data Card 05
data-card-05.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokéathlon Hurdle Dash.
data-card-05.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve won the Hurdle Dash.

data-card-06.name: Data Card 06
data-card-06.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokéathlon Relay Run.
data-card-06.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve won the Relay Run.

data-card-07.name: Data Card 07
data-card-07.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokéathlon Pennant Capture.
data-card-07.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve won Pennant Capture.

data-card-08.name: Data Card 08
data-card-08.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokéathlon Block Smash.
data-card-08.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve won Block Smash.

data-card-09.name: Data Card 09
data-card-09.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokéathlon Disc Catch.
data-card-09.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve won Disc Catch.

data-card-10.name: Data Card 10
data-card-10.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokéathlon Snow Throw.
data-card-10.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve won Snow Throw.

data-card-11.name: Data Card 11
data-card-11.effect: Records the number of points the trainer has earned in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-11.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many points your Pokémon scored.

data-card-12.name: Data Card 12
data-card-12.effect: Records the number of times the trainer’s Pokémon have messed up in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-12.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have failed.

data-card-13.name: Data Card 13
data-card-13.effect: Records the number of times the trainer’s Pokémon have defeated themselves in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-13.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times your Pokémon impeded themselves.

data-card-14.name: Data Card 14
data-card-14.effect: Records the number of times the trainer’s Pokémon have tackled in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-14.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have tackled.

data-card-15.effect: Records the number of times the trainer’s Pokémon have fallen in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-15.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have fallen down.

data-card-16.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokéathlon Ring Drop.
data-card-16.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve won Ring Drop.

data-card-17.name: Data Card 17
data-card-17.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokéathlon Lamp Jump.
data-card-17.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve won Lamp Jump.

data-card-18.name: Data Card 18
data-card-18.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokéathlon Circle Push.
data-card-18.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve won Circle Push.

data-card-19.name: Data Card 19
data-card-19.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first place overall in the Pokéathlon over wirelss.
data-card-19.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many Link Pokéathlon wins you’ve had.

data-card-20.name: Data Card 20
data-card-20.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in last place overall in the Pokéathlon over wireless.
data-card-20.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many Link Pokéathlon losses you’ve had.

data-card-21.name: Data Card 21
data-card-21.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first across all Pokéathlon events.
data-card-21.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve won an event.

data-card-22.name: Data Card 22
data-card-22.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in last across all Pokéathlon events.
data-card-22.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve lost an event.

data-card-23.name: Data Card 23
data-card-23.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has switched Pokémon in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-23.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve switched Pokémon.

data-card-24.name: Data Card 24
data-card-24.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokéathlon Goal Roll.
data-card-24.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve won Goal Roll.

data-card-25.name: Data Card 25
data-card-25.effect: Records the number of times the trainer’s Pokémon received prizes in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-25.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times your Pokémon won individual prizes.

data-card-26.name: Data Card 26
data-card-26.effect: Records the number of times the trainer has instructed Pokémon in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-26.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how many times you’ve instructed your Pokémon.

data-card-27.name: Data Card 27
data-card-27.effect: Records the total time spent in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-27.flavorText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It’s a card that shows how much time you’ve spent in the Pokéathlon.

dawn-stone.name: Dawn Stone
dawn-stone.effect: Evolves a male Kirlia into Gallade or a female Snorunt into Froslass.
dawn-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It sparkles like eyes.

deep-sea-scale.name: Deep Sea Scale
deep-sea-scale.effect: Doubles Clamperl’s Special Defense. Traded on a Clamperl: Holder evolves into Gorebyss.
deep-sea-scale.flavorText: An item to be held by Clamperl. A scale that shines a faint pink, it raises the Sp. Def stat.

deep-sea-tooth.name: Deep Sea Tooth
deep-sea-tooth.effect: Doubles Clamperl’s Special Attack. Traded on a Clamperl: Holder evolves into Huntail.
deep-sea-tooth.flavorText: An item to be held by Clamperl. A fang that gleams a sharp silver, it raises the Sp. Atk stat.

destiny-knot.name: Destiny Knot
destiny-knot.effect: Held: Infatuates opposing Pokémon when holder is inflicted with infatuation.
destiny-knot.flavorText: A long, thin, bright-red string to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder becomes infatuated, the foe does too.

dire-hit.name: Dire Hit
dire-hit.effect: Increases the chance of a critical hit in battle. Raises happiness.
dire-hit.flavorText: It raises the critical-hit ratio greatly. It can be used only once and wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

dire-hit-2.name: Dire Hit 2
dire-hit-2.effect: Raises critical hit rate by two stages in battle. Wonder Launcher only.
dire-hit-2.flavorText: It can be used many times to raise the critical-hit ratio of one Pokémon. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

dire-hit-3.name: Dire Hit 3
dire-hit-3.effect: Raises critical hit rate by three stages in battle. Wonder Launcher only.
dire-hit-3.flavorText: It can be used many times to greatly raise a Pokémon’s critical-hit ratio. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

dive-ball.name: Dive Ball
dive-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 3.5× when underwater, fishing, or surfing.
dive-ball.flavorText: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Pokémon that live underwater.

dome-fossil.name: Dome Fossil
dome-fossil.effect: Can be revived into a Kabuto.
dome-fossil.flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It appears to be part of a shell.

douse-drive.name: Douse Drive
douse-drive.effect: Grants Genesect a blue, Water-type Techno Blast.
douse-drive.flavorText: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Techno Blast to a Water-type move.

dowsing-machine.name: Dowsing Machine
dowsing-machine.effect: Use to find hidden items on the field. AKA Itemfinder.
dowsing-machine.flavorText: It checks for unseen items in the area and makes noise and lights when it finds something.

draco-plate.name: Draco Plate
draco-plate.effect: Held: Dragon-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Dragon.
draco-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dragon-type moves.

dragon-fang.name: Dragon Fang
dragon-fang.effect: Held: Dragon-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
dragon-fang.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a hard and sharp fang that ups the power of Dragon-type moves.

dragon-gem.name: Dragon Gem
dragon-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Dragon-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
dragon-gem.flavorText: A gem with a draconic essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Dragon-type move only once.

dragon-scale.name: Dragon Scale
dragon-scale.effect: Traded on a Seadra: Holder evolves into Kingdra.
dragon-scale.flavorText: A thick and tough scale. Dragon-type Pokémon may be holding this item when caught.

dragon-skull.name: Dragon Skull
dragon-skull.effect: Return to the museum in Nacrene City.
dragon-skull.flavorText: A skull of a Pokémon which was said to have braved the angry waters to fly around the world.

dread-plate.name: Dread Plate
dread-plate.effect: Held: Dark-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Dark.
dread-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dark-type moves.

dream-ball.name: Dream Ball
dream-ball.effect: Catches Pokémon found in the Dream World.
dream-ball.flavorText: A special Poké Ball that appears out of nowhere in a bag at the Entree Forest. It can catch any Pokémon.

dubious-disc.name: Dubious Disc
dubious-disc.effect: Traded on a Porygon2: Holder evolves into Porygon-Z.
dubious-disc.flavorText: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.

durin-berry.name: Durin Berry
durin-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
durin-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

dusk-ball.name: Dusk Ball
dusk-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 3.5× at night and in caves.
dusk-ball.flavorText: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon at night or in dark places like caves.

dusk-stone.name: Dusk Stone
dusk-stone.effect: Evolves a Lampent into Chandelure, a Misdreavus into Mismagius, or a Murkrow into Honchkrow.
dusk-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as dark as dark can be.

earth-plate.name: Earth Plate
earth-plate.effect: Held: Ground-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Ground.
earth-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.

eject-button.name: Eject Button
eject-button.effect: Held: When the holder takes damage from a move, it switches out for a party Pokémon of the Trainer’s choice.
eject-button.flavorText: If the holder is hit by an attack, it will switch with another Pokémon in your party.

electirizer.name: Electirizer
electirizer.effect: Traded on an Electabuzz: Holder evolves into Electivire.
electirizer.flavorText: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

electric-gem.name: Electric Gem
electric-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Electric-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
electric-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of electricity. When held, it strengthens the power of an Electric-type move only once.

elixir.name: Elixir
elixir.flavorText: It restores the PP of all the moves learned by the targeted Pokémon by 10 points each.

energy-powder.name: Energy Powder
energy-powder.flavorText: A very bitter medicine powder. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

energy-root.name: Energy Root
energy-root.flavorText: A very bitter root. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 200 points.

enigma-berry.name: Enigma Berry
enigma-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective attack to restore 1/4 max HP.
enigma-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it restores its HP if it is hit by any supereffective attack.

enigma-stone.name: Enigma Stone
enigma-stone.effect: S: Summons Latias H: Summons Latios.
enigma-stone.flavorText: A crystal ball that was excavated from the ground. A very beautiful stone that is covered with bits of rock and earth.

escape-rope.name: Escape Rope
escape-rope.effect: Transports user to the outside entrance of a cave.
escape-rope.flavorText: A long, durable rope. Use it to escape instantly from a cave or a dungeon.

ether.name: Ether
ether.flavorText: It restores the PP of a Pokémon’s selected move by a maximum of 10 points.

everstone.name: Everstone
everstone.effect: Held: Prevents level-based evolution from occuring.
everstone.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The Pokémon holding this peculiar stone is prevented from evolving.

eviolite.name: Eviolite
eviolite.effect: Held: Holder has 1.5× Defense and Special Defense, as long as it’s not fully evolved.
eviolite.flavorText: A mysterious evolutionary lump. When held, it raises the Defense and Sp. Def of a Pokémon that can still evolve.

exp-share.name: Exp. Share
exp-share.effect: Held: Half the experience from a battle is split between Pokémon holding this item.
exp-share.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder gets a share of a battle’s Exp. Points without battling.

expert-belt.name: Expert Belt
expert-belt.effect: Held: Holder’s Super Effective moves do 20% extra damage.
expert-belt.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a well-worn belt that slightly boosts the power of supereffective moves.

explorer-kit.name: Explorer Kit
explorer-kit.flavorText: A bag filled with convenient tools for exploring. It provides access to the Underground.

fashion-case.name: Fashion Case
fashion-case.effect: Holds Pokémon Accessories for use in Contests.
fashion-case.flavorText: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.

fast-ball.name: Fast Ball
fast-ball.effect: 4× effectiveness on Pokémon with 100 or greater base speed. (Gen II: Roaming or Fleeing Pokémon). Made from Wht Apricorn.
fast-ball.flavorText: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon which are quick to run away.

favored-mail.name: Favored Mail
favored-mail.effect: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.
favored-mail.flavorText: Stationery designed for writing about your favorite things. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

fighting-gem.name: Fighting Gem
fighting-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Fighting-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
fighting-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of combat. When held, it strengthens the power of a Fighting-type move only once.

figy-berry.name: Figy Berry
figy-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to restore 1/8 max HP. Confuses Pokémon that dislike spicy flavor.
figy-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it restores the user’s HP in a pinch, but will cause confusion if it hates the taste.

fire-gem.name: Fire Gem
fire-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Fire-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
fire-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of fire. When held, it strengthens the power of a Fire-type move only once.

fire-stone.name: Fire Stone
fire-stone.effect: Evolves an Eevee into Flareon, a Growlithe into Arcanine, a Pansear into Simisear, or a Vulpix into Ninetales.
fire-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is colored orange.

fist-plate.name: Fist Plate
fist-plate.effect: Held: Fighting-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Fighting.
fist-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fighting-type moves.

flame-orb.name: Flame Orb
flame-orb.effect: Held: Inflicts Burn on the holder at the end of the turn. Activates after Burn damage would occur.
flame-orb.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that inflicts a burn on the holder in battle.

flame-plate.name: Flame Plate
flame-plate.effect: Held: Fire-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Fire.
flame-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fire-type moves.

float-stone.name: Float Stone
float-stone.flavorText: A very light stone. It reduces the weight of a Pokémon when held.

fluffy-tail.name: Fluffy Tail
fluffy-tail.flavorText: An item that attracts Pokémon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pokémon.

flying-gem.name: Flying Gem
flying-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Flying-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
flying-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of air. When held, it strengthens the power of a Flying-type move only once.

focus-band.name: Focus Band
focus-band.effect: Held: Holder has 10% chance to survive attacks or self-inflicted damage at 1 HP.
focus-band.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder may endure a potential KO attack, leaving it with just 1 HP.

focus-sash.name: Focus Sash
focus-sash.effect: Held: Holder survives any single-hit attack at 1 HP if at max HP, then the item is consumed.
focus-sash.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If it has full HP, the holder will endure one potential KO attack, leaving 1 HP.

fresh-water.name: Fresh Water
fresh-water.flavorText: Water with a high mineral content. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

friend-ball.name: Friend Ball
friend-ball.effect: Caught Pokémon start with 200 happiness. Made from Grn Apricorn.
friend-ball.flavorText: A Poké Ball that makes caught Pokémon more friendly.

full-heal.name: Full Heal
full-heal.effect: Cures any status ailment and confusion.
full-heal.flavorText: A spray-type medicine. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

full-incense.name: Full Incense
full-incense.effect: Held: Holder moves last in its priority bracket. Breeding: Snorlax begets a Munchlax Egg.
full-incense.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that makes the holder bloated and slow moving.

full-restore.name: Full Restore
full-restore.effect: Restores HP to full and cures any status ailment and confusion.
full-restore.flavorText: A medicine that fully restores the HP and heals any status problems of a single Pokémon.

galactic-key.name: Galactic Key
galactic-key.effect: Grants access to Galactic HQ in Veilstone City.
galactic-key.flavorText: A card key for disengaging security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.

ganlon-berry.name: Ganlon Berry
ganlon-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/4 max HP to boost Defense.
ganlon-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Defense stat in a pinch.

gb-sounds.name: GB Sounds
gb-sounds.effect: Use to listen to GameBoy era audio.
gb-sounds.flavorText: A music player that allows you to listen to nostalgic songs. It’s operated with a single switch.

genius-wing.name: Genius Feather
genius-wing.flavorText: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Sp. Atk stat of a single Pokémon.

ghost-gem.name: Ghost Gem
ghost-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Ghost-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
ghost-gem.flavorText: A gem with a spectral essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Ghost-type move only once.

good-rod.name: Good Rod
good-rod.effect: Used to catch Pokémon in bodies of water.
good-rod.flavorText: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

gooey-mulch.name: Gooey Mulch
gooey-mulch.effect: Berries regrow from dead plants an increased number of times.
gooey-mulch.flavorText: A fertilizer to be spread on soft soil in regions where Berries are grown. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

gracidea.name: Gracidea
gracidea.effect: Changes an unfrozen Shaymin to Sky Forme in the day.
gracidea.flavorText: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions like birthdays.

gram-1.name: Gram 1
gram-1.effect: Part of a sidequest to obtain TM89.
gram-1.flavorText: An important letter which Wingull delivers.

gram-2.name: Gram 2
gram-2.effect: Part of a sidequest to obtain TM89.
gram-2.flavorText: An important letter which Wingull delivers.

gram-3.name: Gram 3
gram-3.effect: Part of a sidequest to obtain TM89.
gram-3.flavorText: An important letter which Wingull delivers.

grass-gem.name: Grass Gem
grass-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Grass-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
grass-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of nature. When held, it strengthens the power of a Grass-type move only once.

great-ball.name: Great Ball
great-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 1.5×.
great-ball.flavorText: A good, high-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.

green-apricorn.name: Green Apricorn
green-apricorn.effect: Used to make a Friend Ball.
green-apricorn.flavorText: A green Apricorn. It has a mysterious, aromatic scent.

green-scarf.name: Green Scarf
green-scarf.effect: Raises the holder’s Smartness while in a contest.
green-scarf.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the Smart aspect of the holder in a Contest.

green-shard.name: Green Shard
green-shard.effect: No effect. Can be traded for items or moves.
green-shard.flavorText: A small green shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.

greet-mail.name: Greet Mail
greet-mail.effect: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.
greet-mail.flavorText: Stationery designed for introductory greetings. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

grepa-berry.name: Grepa Berry
grepa-berry.effect: Drops Special Defense Effort Values by 10 and raises happiness.
grepa-berry.flavorText: Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly, but it also lowers its base Sp. Def stat.

grip-claw.name: Grip Claw
grip-claw.effect: Held: Holder’s multi-turn trapping moves last 5 turns.
grip-claw.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of multiturn attacks like Bind and Wrap.

griseous-orb.name: Griseous Orb
griseous-orb.effect: Boosts the damage from Giratina’s Dragon-type and Ghost-type moves by 20%, and transforms it into Origin Forme.
griseous-orb.flavorText: A glowing orb to be held by Giratina. It boosts the power of Dragon- and Ghost-type moves.

ground-gem.name: Ground Gem
ground-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Ground-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
ground-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of land. When held, it strengthens the power of a Ground-type move only once.

growth-mulch.name: Growth Mulch
growth-mulch.effect: Growing time of berries is reduced, but the soil dries out faster.
growth-mulch.flavorText: A fertilizer to be spread on soft soil in regions where Berries are grown. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

guard-spec.name: Guard Spec.
guard-spec.effect: Prevents stat changes in battle for five turns in battle. Raises happiness.
guard-spec.flavorText: An item that prevents stat reduction among the Trainer’s party Pokémon for five turns after use.

haban-berry.name: Haban Berry
haban-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Dragon-type attack to halve the damage.
haban-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Dragon-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

hard-stone.name: Hard Stone
hard-stone.effect: Held: Rock-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
hard-stone.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an unbreakable stone that ups the power of Rock-type moves.

heal-ball.name: Heal Ball
heal-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Caught Pokémon are immediately healed.
heal-ball.flavorText: A remedial Poké Ball that restores the caught Pokémon’s HP and eliminates any status problem.

heal-powder.name: Heal Powder
heal-powder.effect: Cures any status ailment, but lowers happiness.
heal-powder.flavorText: A very bitter medicine powder. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

health-wing.name: Health Feather
health-wing.flavorText: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base HP of a single Pokémon.

heart-scale.name: Heart Scale
heart-scale.effect: No effect. Can be traded for prior Level-up moves.
heart-scale.flavorText: A pretty, heart-shaped scale that is extremely rare. It glows faintly in the colors of the rainbow.

heat-rock.name: Heat Rock
heat-rock.effect: Held: Sunny Day by the holder lasts 8 rounds instead of 5.
heat-rock.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Sunny Day used by the holder.

heavy-ball.name: Heavy Ball
heavy-ball.effect: Has flat bonus or penalty to catch rate depending on weight class of target. Made from Blk Apricorn.
heavy-ball.flavorText: A Poké Ball for catching very heavy Pokémon.

helix-fossil.name: Helix Fossil
helix-fossil.effect: Can be revived into an Omanyte.
helix-fossil.flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It appears to be part of a seashell.

hm01.name: HM01
hm01.effect: Teaches Cut to a compatible Pokémon.
hm01.flavorText: The target is cut with a scythe or claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

hm02.name: HM02
hm02.effect: Teaches Fly to a compatible Pokémon.
hm02.flavorText: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used to fly to any familiar town.

hm03.name: HM03
hm03.effect: Teaches Surf to a compatible Pokémon.
hm03.flavorText: It swamps the area around the user with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

hm04.name: HM04
hm04.effect: Teaches Strength to a compatible Pokémon.
hm04.flavorText: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. This move can also be used to move boulders.

hm05.name: HM05
hm05.effect: Teaches Waterfall to a compatible Pokémon. (HS: Whirlpool DPP: Defog Gen III & II & I: Flash)
hm05.flavorText: The user charges the target at an awesome speed. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

hm06.name: HM06
hm06.effect: Teaches Dive to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV & III: Rock Smash Gen II: Whirlpool)
hm06.flavorText: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the second. It can be used for diving in the ocean.

hondew-berry.name: Hondew Berry
hondew-berry.effect: Drops Special Attack Effort Values by 10 and raises happiness.
hondew-berry.flavorText: Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly, but it also lowers its base Sp. Atk stat.

honey.name: Honey
honey.flavorText: A sweet honey with a lush aroma that attracts wild Pokémon when it is used in grass, caves, or on special trees.

hp-up.name: HP Up
hp-up.flavorText: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base HP of a single Pokémon.

hyper-potion.name: Hyper Potion
hyper-potion.flavorText: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 200 points.

iapapa-berry.name: Iapapa Berry
iapapa-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to restore 1/8 max HP. Confuses Pokémon that dislike sour flavor.
iapapa-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it restores the user’s HP in a pinch, but will cause confusion if it hates the taste.

ice-gem.name: Ice Gem
ice-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Ice-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
ice-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of ice. When held, it strengthens the power of an Ice-type move only once.

ice-heal.name: Ice Heal
ice-heal.flavorText: A spray-type medicine. It defrosts a Pokémon that has been frozen solid.

icicle-plate.name: Icicle Plate
icicle-plate.effect: Held: Ice-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Ice.
icicle-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ice-type moves.

icy-rock.name: Icy Rock
icy-rock.effect: Held: Hail by the holder lasts 8 rounds instead of 5.
icy-rock.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Hail used by the holder.

inquiry-mail.name: Inquiry Mail
inquiry-mail.effect: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.
inquiry-mail.flavorText: Stationery designed for writing questions. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

insect-plate.name: Insect Plate
insect-plate.effect: Held: Bug-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Bug.
insect-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Bug-type moves.

iron.name: Iron
iron.flavorText: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Defense stat of a single Pokémon.

iron-ball.name: Iron Ball
iron-ball.effect: Held: Holder’s Speed is halved. Negates all Ground-type immunities, and makes Flying-types take neutral damage from Ground-type moves. Arena Trap. Spikes, and Toxic Spikes affect the holder.
iron-ball.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that cuts Speed. It makes Flying-type and levitating holders susceptible to Ground moves.

iron-plate.name: Iron Plate
iron-plate.effect: Held: Steel-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Steel.
iron-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Steel-type moves.

item-drop.name: Item Drop
item-drop.effect: Forces a friendly Pokémon to drop its held item.
item-drop.flavorText: When used, it causes an ally Pokémon to drop a held item.

item-urge.name: Item Urge
item-urge.effect: Forcibly activates a friendly Pokémon’s held item.
item-urge.flavorText: When used, it causes an ally Pokémon to use its held item.

jaboca-berry.name: Jaboca Berry
jaboca-berry.effect: Held: Consumed to deal 1/8 attacker’s max HP when holder is struck by a physical attack.
jaboca-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon and a physical attack lands, the attacker also takes damage.

jade-orb.name: Jade Orb
jade-orb.effect: Summons Rayquaza to the Embedded Tower.
jade-orb.flavorText: A shiny green orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.

journal.name: Journal
journal.effect: Records prior significant activities the player took.
journal.flavorText: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.

kasib-berry.name: Kasib Berry
kasib-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Ghost-type attack to halve the damage.
kasib-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Ghost-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

kebia-berry.name: Kebia Berry
kebia-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Poison-type attack to halve the damage.
kebia-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Poison-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

kelpsy-berry.name: Kelpsy Berry
kelpsy-berry.effect: Drops Attack Effort Values by 10 and raises happiness.
kelpsy-berry.flavorText: Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly, but it also lowers its base Attack stat.

kings-rock.name: King’s Rock
kings-rock.effect: Held: Damaging moves gain a 10% chance to make their target flinch. Traded on a Poliwhirl: Holder evolves into Politoed. Traded on a Slowpoke: Holder evolves into Slowking.
kings-rock.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder inflicts damage, the target may flinch.

lagging-tail.name: Lagging Tail
lagging-tail.effect: Held: Holder moves last in its priority bracket.
lagging-tail.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is tremendously heavy and makes the holder move slower than usual.

lansat-berry.name: Lansat Berry
lansat-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/4 max HP to boost critical hit ratio by two stages.
lansat-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its critical-hit ratio in a pinch.

lava-cookie.name: Lava Cookie
lava-cookie.effect: Cures any status ailment and confusion.
lava-cookie.flavorText: Lavaridge Town’s local specialty. It heals all the status problems of one Pokémon.

lax-incense.name: Lax Incense
lax-incense.effect: Held: Holder’s evasion is increased by 5%. Breeding: Wobbuffet begets a Wynaut Egg.
lax-incense.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The tricky aroma of this incense may make attacks miss the holder.

leaf-stone.name: Leaf Stone
leaf-stone.effect: Evolves an Exeggcute into Exeggutor, a Gloom into Vileplume, a Nuzleaf into Shiftry, a Pansage into Simisage, or a Weepinbell into Victreebel.
leaf-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a leaf pattern.

leftovers.name: Leftovers
leftovers.effect: Held: Restores 1/16 (6.25%) holder’s max HP at the end of each turn.
leftovers.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder’s HP is gradually restored during battle.

lemonade.name: Lemonade
lemonade.flavorText: A very sweet drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 80 points.

leppa-berry.name: Leppa Berry
leppa-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when a move runs out of PP to restore its PP by 10.
leppa-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it restores a move’s PP by 10.

level-ball.name: Level Ball
level-ball.effect: Success rate based off of fraction target Pokémon is of user’s Pokémon. Made from Red Apricorn.
level-ball.flavorText: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that are a lower level than your own.

liberty-pass.name: Liberty Pass
liberty-pass.effect: Allows access to Liberty Garden and Victini.
liberty-pass.flavorText: A special pass to go to Liberty Garden. Board the ship in Castelia City.

liechi-berry.name: Liechi Berry
liechi-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/4 max HP to boost Attack.
liechi-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Attack stat in a pinch.

life-orb.name: Life Orb
life-orb.effect: Held: Holder’s moves inflict 30% extra damage, but cost 10% max HP.
life-orb.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of moves, but at the cost of some HP on each hit.

light-ball.name: Light Ball
light-ball.effect: Doubles Pikachu’s Attack and Special Attack. Breed on Pikachu or Raichu: Pichu Egg will have Volt Tackle.
light-ball.flavorText: An item to be held by Pikachu. It is a puzzling orb that raises the Attack and Sp. Atk stat.

light-clay.name: Light Clay
light-clay.effect: Held: Light Screen and Reflect used by the holder last 8 rounds instead of 5.
light-clay.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of barrier moves like Light Screen and Reflect used by the holder.

light-stone.name: Light Stone
light-stone.effect: Summons Reshiram for the final battle against N.
light-stone.flavorText: Reshiram’s body was destroyed and changed into this stone. It is said to be waiting for the emergence of a hero.

like-mail.name: Like Mail
like-mail.effect: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.
like-mail.flavorText: Stationery designed for writing recommendations. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

lock-capsule.name: Lock Capsule
lock-capsule.flavorText: A sturdy Capsule that can only be opened with a special key.

loot-sack.name: Loot Sack
loot-sack.flavorText: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry loot obtained in the coal mine.

lost-item.name: Lost Item
lost-item.effect: A Poké Doll lost by the Copycat who lives in Saffron City. Trade for a Pass.
lost-item.flavorText: The Mime Jr. doll that was lost by the Copycat.

love-ball.name: Love Ball
love-ball.effect: 8× effectiveness on opposite sex, same species targets of the Active Pokémon. Made from Pnk Apricorn.
love-ball.flavorText: Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that are the opposite gender of your Pokémon.

luck-incense.name: Luck Incense
luck-incense.effect: Held: Doubles the money earned from a battle. Does not stack with Amulet Coin. Breeding: Chansey and Blissey beget a Happiny Egg.
luck-incense.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles a battle’s prize money if the holding Pokémon joins in.

lucky-egg.name: Lucky Egg
lucky-egg.effect: Held: Increases EXP earned in battle by 50%.
lucky-egg.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an egg filled with happiness that earns extra Exp. Points in battle.

lucky-punch.name: Lucky Punch
lucky-punch.effect: Raises Chansey’s critical hit ratio by two stages.
lucky-punch.flavorText: An item to be held by Chansey. It is a pair of gloves that boosts Chansey’s critical-hit ratio.

lum-berry.name: Lum Berry
lum-berry.effect: Held: Consumed to cure any status condition or confusion.
lum-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it recovers from any status problem.

lunar-wing.name: Lunar Wing
lunar-wing.effect: Cures sailor’s son of nightmares in Canalave City.
lunar-wing.flavorText: A feather that glows like the moon. It is said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.

lure-ball.name: Lure Ball
lure-ball.effect: 3× effectiveness while fishing. Made from Blu Apricorn.
lure-ball.flavorText: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon hooked by a Rod when fishing.

lustrous-orb.name: Lustrous Orb
lustrous-orb.effect: Boosts the damage from Palkia’s Dragon-type and Water-type moves by 20%.
lustrous-orb.flavorText: A beautifully glowing orb to be held by Palkia. It boosts the power of Dragon-​ and Water-type moves.

luxury-ball.name: Luxury Ball
luxury-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Caught Pokémon start with 200 happiness.
luxury-ball.flavorText: A comfortable Poké Ball that makes a caught wild Pokémon quickly grow friendly.

machine-part.name: Machine Part
machine-part.effect: Must be replaced in the Power Plant to power the Magnet Train.
machine-part.flavorText: An important machine part for the Power Plant that was stolen.

macho-brace.name: Macho Brace
macho-brace.effect: Held: Holder gains double effort values from battles, but has halved Speed in battle.
macho-brace.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stiff and heavy brace that promotes strong growth but lowers Speed.

magma-stone.name: Magma Stone
magma-stone.flavorText: A stone formed when boulders melted in intensely hot magma, then hardened. Magma remains sealed inside.

magmarizer.name: Magmarizer
magmarizer.effect: Traded on a Magmar: Holder evolves into Magmortar.
magmarizer.flavorText: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

magnet.name: Magnet
magnet.effect: Held: Electric-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
magnet.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a powerful magnet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.

mago-berry.name: Mago Berry
mago-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to restore 1/8 max HP. Confuses Pokémon that dislike sweet flavor.
mago-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it restores the user’s HP in a pinch, but will cause confusion if it hates the taste.

magost-berry.name: Magost Berry
magost-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
magost-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

master-ball.name: Master Ball
master-ball.effect: Catches a wild Pokémon every time.
master-ball.flavorText: The best Ball with the ultimate level of performance. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.

max-elixir.name: Max Elixir
max-elixir.effect: Restores PP to full for each move.
max-elixir.flavorText: It fully restores the PP of all the moves learned by the targeted Pokémon.

max-ether.name: Max Ether
max-ether.effect: Restores PP to full for one move.
max-ether.flavorText: It fully restores the PP of a single selected move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.

max-potion.name: Max Potion
max-potion.flavorText: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It completely restores the HP of a single Pokémon.

max-repel.name: Max Repel
max-repel.effect: For 250 steps, prevents wild encounters of level lower than your party’s lead Pokémon.
max-repel.flavorText: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 250 steps after its use.

max-revive.name: Max Revive
max-revive.flavorText: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon. It fully restores the Pokémon’s HP.

meadow-plate.name: Meadow Plate
meadow-plate.effect: Held: Grass-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Grass.
meadow-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

member-card.name: Member Card
member-card.effect: Allows access to Newmoon Island and Darkrai.
member-card.flavorText: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.

mental-herb.name: Mental Herb
mental-herb.effect: Held: Consumed to cure infatuation. Gen V: Also removes Taunt, Encore, Torment, Disable, and Cursed Body.
mental-herb.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It snaps the holder out of infatuation. It can be used only once.

metal-coat.name: Metal Coat
metal-coat.effect: Held: Steel-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
metal-coat.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a special metallic film that ups the power of Steel-type moves.

metal-powder.name: Metal Powder
metal-powder.effect: Raises Ditto’s Defense and Special Defense by 50%. The boost is lost after transforming.
metal-powder.flavorText: An item to be held by Ditto. Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts the Defense stat.

metronome.name: Metronome
metronome.effect: Held: Consectutive uses of the same attack have a cumulative damage boost of 10%. Maximum 100% boost.
metronome.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that boosts a move used consecutively. Its effect is reset if another move is used.

micle-berry.name: Micle Berry
micle-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/4 max HP to boost accuracy of next move by 20%. (Gen IV: Perfect accuracy)
micle-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it raises the accuracy of a move just once in a pinch.

mind-plate.name: Mind Plate
mind-plate.effect: Held: Psychic-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Psychic.
mind-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.

miracle-seed.name: Miracle Seed
miracle-seed.effect: Held: Grass-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
miracle-seed.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a seed imbued with life that ups the power of Grass-type moves.

moomoo-milk.name: Moomoo Milk
moomoo-milk.flavorText: Milk with a very high nutrition content. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 100 points.

moon-ball.name: Moon Ball
moon-ball.effect: 4× effectiveness on familes of Pokémon with a Moon Stone evolution. Made from Ylw Apricorn.
moon-ball.flavorText: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that evolve using the Moon Stone.

moon-stone.name: Moon Stone
moon-stone.effect: Evolves a Clefairy into Clefable, a Jigglypuff into Wigglytuff, a Munna into Musharna, a Nidorina into Nidoqueen, a Nidorino into Nidoking, or a Skitty into Delcatty.
moon-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as black as the night sky.

muscle-band.name: Muscle Band
muscle-band.effect: Held: Boosts the damage of physical moves used by the holder by 10%.
muscle-band.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a headband that slightly boosts the power of physical moves.

muscle-wing.name: Muscle Feather
muscle-wing.flavorText: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Attack stat of a single Pokémon.

mystery-egg.name: Mystery Egg
mystery-egg.flavorText: A mysterious Egg obtained from Mr. Pokémon. What’s in the Egg is unknown.

mystic-water.name: Mystic Water
mystic-water.effect: Held: Water-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
mystic-water.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a teardrop-shaped gem that ups the power of Water-type moves.

nanab-berry.name: Nanab Berry
nanab-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
nanab-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

nest-ball.name: Nest Ball
nest-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 3.9× for level 1 Pokémon, and drops steadily to 1× at level 30.
nest-ball.flavorText: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on weaker Pokémon in the wild.

net-ball.name: Net Ball
net-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 3× for water and bug Pokémon.
net-ball.flavorText: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Water- and Bug-type Pokémon.

never-melt-ice.name: Never-Melt Ice
never-melt-ice.effect: Held: Ice-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
never-melt-ice.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a piece of ice that repels heat and boosts Ice-type moves.

nomel-berry.name: Nomel Berry
nomel-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
nomel-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

normal-gem.name: Normal Gem
normal-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Normal-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
normal-gem.flavorText: A gem with an ordinary essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Normal-type move only once.

nugget.name: Nugget
nugget.effect: Sell for 5000 Pokédollars, or to Ore Collector for 10000 Pokédollars.
nugget.flavorText: A nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

oaks-letter.name: Oak’s Letter
oaks-letter.effect: Allows access to Seabreak path, Flower Paradise, and Shaymin.
oaks-letter.flavorText: A letter from Prof. Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Rt. 224.

occa-berry.name: Occa Berry
occa-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Fire-type attack to halve the damage.
occa-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Fire-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

odd-incense.name: Odd Incense
odd-incense.effect: Held: Psychic-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Breeding: Mr. Mime begets a Mime Jr. Egg.
odd-incense.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.

odd-keystone.name: Odd Keystone
odd-keystone.effect: Use on the tower on Route 209 to encounter Spiritomb if you have at least 32 Underground greetings.
odd-keystone.flavorText: A vital item that is needed to keep a stone tower from collapsing. Voices can be heard from it occasionally.

old-amber.name: Old Amber
old-amber.effect: Can be revived into an Aerodactyl.
old-amber.flavorText: A piece of amber that contains the genetic material of an ancient Pokémon. It is clear with a reddish tint.

old-charm.name: Old Charm
old-charm.effect: Trade to Cynthia’s grandmother in Celestic Town for HM04 (Surf).
old-charm.flavorText: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.

old-gateau.name: Old Gateau
old-gateau.effect: Cures any status ailment and confusion.
old-gateau.flavorText: Old Chateau’s hidden specialty. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

old-rod.name: Old Rod
old-rod.effect: Used to catch Pokémon in bodies of water.
old-rod.flavorText: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

oran-berry.name: Oran Berry
oran-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to recover 10 HP.
oran-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it heals the user by just 10 HP.

oval-stone.name: Oval Stone
oval-stone.effect: Level-up during Day on a Happiny: Holder evolves into Chansey.
oval-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is shaped like an egg.

pal-pad.name: Pal Pad
pal-pad.effect: Use to record Friend Codes and check your own.
pal-pad.flavorText: A convenient notepad that is used for registering your friends, Friend Codes, and keeping a record of game play.

pamtre-berry.name: Pamtre Berry
pamtre-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
pamtre-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

paralyze-heal.name: Paralyze Heal
paralyze-heal.flavorText: A spray-type medicine. It eliminates paralysis from a single Pokémon.

parcel.name: Parcel
parcel.effect: Given to the trainer’s rival in Jubilife City. Contains Town Maps.
parcel.flavorText: A parcel entrusted in your care. You are supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.

park-ball.name: Park Ball
park-ball.effect: Catches Pokémon in the Pal Park every time.
park-ball.flavorText: A special Poké Ball for the Pal Park.

pass.name: Pass
pass.effect: Grants access to ride the Magnet Train between Goldenrod City and Saffron City.
pass.flavorText: A ticket required for riding the Magnet Train. It allows you to ride whenever and however much you’d like.

pass-orb.name: Pass Orb
pass-orb.flavorText: A mysterious orb containing the power of the Unova region, to be used when generating Pass Power.

passho-berry.name: Passho Berry
passho-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Water-type attack to halve the damage.
passho-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Water-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

payapa-berry.name: Payapa Berry
payapa-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Psychic-type attack to halve the damage.
payapa-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Psychic-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

pearl.name: Pearl
pearl.effect: Sell for 700 Pokédollars, or to Ore Collector for 1400 Pokédollars.
pearl.flavorText: A somewhat-small pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold cheaply to shops.

pearl-string.name: Pearl String
pearl-string.effect: Sell to Ore Collector for 25000 Pokédollars.
pearl-string.flavorText: Very large pearls that sparkle in a pretty silver color. A maniac will buy them for a high price.

pecha-berry.name: Pecha Berry
pecha-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when poisoned to cure poison.
pecha-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it recovers from poison.

persim-berry.name: Persim Berry
persim-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when confused to cure confusion.
persim-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it recovers from confusion.

petaya-berry.name: Petaya Berry
petaya-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/4 max HP to boost Special Attack.
petaya-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Sp. Atk stat in a pinch.

photo-album.name: Photo Album
photo-album.flavorText: A nice photo album for storing all the photos taken along your adventure.

pinap-berry.name: Pinap Berry
pinap-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
pinap-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

pink-apricorn.name: Pink Apricorn
pink-apricorn.effect: Used to make a Love Ball.
pink-apricorn.flavorText: A pink Apricorn. It has a nice, sweet scent.

pink-scarf.name: Pink Scarf
pink-scarf.effect: Raises the holder’s Cuteness while in a contest.
pink-scarf.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the Cute aspect of the holder in a Contest.

plume-fossil.name: Plume Fossil
plume-fossil.effect: Can be revived into an Archen.
plume-fossil.flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that flew in the sky in ancient times. It appears to be part of its wing.

poffin-case.name: Poffin Case
poffin-case.flavorText: A case for storing Poffin cooked from Berries.

point-card.name: Point Card
point-card.effect: Keeps count of Battle Points earned.
point-card.flavorText: A card that lists the Battle Points you have earned.

poison-barb.name: Poison Barb
poison-barb.effect: Held: Poison-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
poison-barb.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a small, poisonous barb that ups the power of Poison-type moves.

poison-gem.name: Poison Gem
poison-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Poison-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
poison-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of poison. When held, it strengthens the power of a Poison-type move only once.

poke-ball.name: Poké Ball
poke-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.
poke-ball.flavorText: A device for catching wild Pokémon. It is thrown like a ball at the target. It is designed as a capsule system.

poke-doll.name: Poké Doll
poke-doll.flavorText: A doll that attracts Pokémon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pokémon.

poke-radar.name: Poké Radar
poke-radar.effect: Use to track down rare or shiny Pokémon. 50 steps to recharge.
poke-radar.flavorText: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.

poke-toy.name: Poké Toy
poke-toy.flavorText: An item that attracts Pokémon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pokémon.

pomeg-berry.name: Pomeg Berry
pomeg-berry.effect: Drops HP Effort Values by 10 and raises happiness.
pomeg-berry.flavorText: Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly, but it also lowers its base HP.

potion.name: Potion
potion.flavorText: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.

power-anklet.name: Power Anklet
power-anklet.effect: Held: Holder gains 4 Speed effort values, but has halved Speed in battle.
power-anklet.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that promotes Speed gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

power-band.name: Power Band
power-band.effect: Held: Holder gains 4 Special Defense effort values, but has halved Speed in battle.
power-band.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that promotes Sp. Def gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

power-belt.name: Power Belt
power-belt.effect: Held: Holder gains 4 Defense effort values, but has halved Speed in battle.
power-belt.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that promotes Defense gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

power-bracer.name: Power Bracer
power-bracer.effect: Held: Holder gains 4 Attack effort values, but has halved Speed in battle.
power-bracer.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that promotes Attack gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

power-herb.name: Power Herb
power-herb.effect: Held: Both turns of a two-turn charge move happen at once. Consumed upon use.
power-herb.flavorText: A single-use item to be held by a Pokémon. It allows the immediate use of a move that charges on the first turn.

power-lens.name: Power Lens
power-lens.effect: Held: Holder gains 4 Special Attack effort values, but has halved Speed in battle.
power-lens.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that promotes Sp. Atk gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

power-weight.name: Power Weight
power-weight.effect: Held: Holder gains 4 HP effort values, but has halved Speed in battle.
power-weight.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that promotes HP gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

pp-max.name: PP Max
pp-max.effect: Raises a move’s max PP by 60%.
pp-max.flavorText: It maximally raises the top PP of a selected move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.

pp-up.name: PP Up
pp-up.effect: Raises a move’s max PP by 20%.
pp-up.flavorText: It slightly raises the maximum PP of a selected move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.

premier-ball.name: Premier Ball
premier-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.
premier-ball.flavorText: A somewhat rare Poké Ball that has been specially made to commemorate an event of some sort.

pretty-wing.name: Pretty Feather
pretty-wing.flavorText: Though this feather is beautiful, it’s just a regular feather and has no effect on Pokémon.

prism-scale.name: Prism Scale
prism-scale.effect: Traded on a Feebas: Holder evolves into Milotic.
prism-scale.flavorText: A mysterious scale that evolves certain Pokémon. It shines in rainbow colors.

prop-case.name: Prop Case
prop-case.effect: Stores props for the Pokémon Musical.
prop-case.flavorText: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.

protector.name: Protector
protector.effect: Traded on a Rhydon: Holder evolves into Rhyperior.
protector.flavorText: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

protein.name: Protein
protein.flavorText: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Attack stat of a single Pokémon.

psychic-gem.name: Psychic Gem
psychic-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Psychic-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
psychic-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of the mind. When held, it strengthens the power of a Psychic-type move only once.

pure-incense.name: Pure Incense
pure-incense.effect: Prevents wild encounters of level lower than your party’s lead Pokémon. Breeding: Chimecho begets a Chingling Egg.
pure-incense.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the first one in the party.

qualot-berry.name: Qualot Berry
qualot-berry.effect: Drops Defense Effort Values by 10 and raises happiness.
qualot-berry.flavorText: Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly, but it also lowers its base Defense stat.

quick-ball.name: Quick Ball
quick-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 4× (Gen V: 5×), but only on the first turn.
quick-ball.flavorText: A somewhat different Poké Ball that provides a better catch rate if it is used at the start of a wild encounter.

quick-claw.name: Quick Claw
quick-claw.effect: Held: Holder has a 3/16 (18.75%) chance to move first.
quick-claw.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A light, sharp claw that lets the bearer move first occasionally.

quick-powder.name: Quick Powder
quick-powder.effect: Doubles Ditto’s Speed when held. The boost is lost after transforming.
quick-powder.flavorText: An item to be held by Ditto. Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts the Speed stat.

rabuta-berry.name: Rabuta Berry
rabuta-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
rabuta-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

rage-candy-bar.name: Rage Candy Bar
rage-candy-bar.effect: HS: Traded for TM64. Gen II & Gen V: Acts as a Potion.
rage-candy-bar.flavorText: A famous Mahogany Town candy tourists like to buy and take home. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 20 points.

rainbow-wing.name: Rainbow Wing
rainbow-wing.effect: Summons Ho-Oh at the top of the Bell Tower.
rainbow-wing.flavorText: A mystical rainbow feather that sparkles.

rare-bone.name: Rare Bone
rare-bone.effect: Sell for 5000 Pokédollars, or to Bone Man for 10000 Pokédollars.
rare-bone.flavorText: A bone that is extremely valuable for Pokémon archeology. It can be sold for a high price to shops.

rare-candy.name: Rare Candy
rare-candy.effect: Causes a level-up and raises happiness.
rare-candy.flavorText: A candy that is packed with energy. It raises the level of a single Pokémon by one.

rawst-berry.name: Rawst Berry
rawst-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when burned to cure a burn.
rawst-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it recovers from a burn.

razor-claw.name: Razor Claw
razor-claw.effect: Held: Raises the holder’s critical hit ratio by one stage. Held by a Sneasel while levelling up at night: Holder evolves into Weavile.
razor-claw.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sharply hooked claw that ups the holder’s critical-hit ratio.

razor-fang.name: Razor Fang
razor-fang.effect: Held: Damaging moves gain a 10% chance to make their target flinch. Held by a Gligar while levelling up: Holder evolves into Gliscor.
razor-fang.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may make foes and allies flinch when the holder inflicts damage.

razz-berry.name: Razz Berry
razz-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
razz-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

reaper-cloth.name: Reaper Cloth
reaper-cloth.effect: Traded on a Dusclops: Holder evolves into Dusknoir.
reaper-cloth.flavorText: A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong spiritual energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

red-apricorn.name: Red Apricorn
red-apricorn.effect: Used to make a Level Ball.
red-apricorn.flavorText: A red Apricorn. It assails your nostrils.

red-card.name: Red Card
red-card.effect: Held: When the holder takes damage from a move, the opponent switches out for another random party Pokémon. Consumed after use.
red-card.flavorText: A card with a mysterious power. When the holder is struck by a foe, the attacker is removed from battle.

red-chain.name: Red Chain
red-chain.effect: Used to bind Palkia and Dialga.
red-chain.flavorText: A mythical chain that is said to link the legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.

red-flute.name: Red Flute
red-flute.flavorText: A toy flute made from red glass. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

red-orb.name: Red Orb
red-orb.effect: Summons Groudon to the Embedded Tower.
red-orb.flavorText: A shiny red orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.

red-scale.name: Red Scale
