red-scale.effect: Trade to Mr. Pokémon for an Exp. Share.
red-scale.flavorText: A scale from the red Gyarados. It glows red like a flame.

red-scarf.name: Red Scarf
red-scarf.effect: Raises the holder’s Coolness while in a contest.
red-scarf.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the Cool aspect of the holder in a Contest.

red-shard.name: Red Shard
red-shard.effect: No effect. Can be traded for items or moves.
red-shard.flavorText: A small red shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.

relic-band.name: Relic Band
relic-band.effect: Sell to Villa Owner for 100000 Pokédollars.
relic-band.flavorText: A bracelet made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

relic-copper.name: Relic Copper
relic-copper.effect: Sell to Villa Owner for 1000 Pokédollars.
relic-copper.flavorText: A copper coin used in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

relic-crown.name: Relic Crown
relic-crown.effect: Sell to Villa Owner for 300000 Pokédollars.
relic-crown.flavorText: A crown made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

relic-gold.name: Relic Gold
relic-gold.flavorText: A gold coin used in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

relic-silver.name: Relic Silver
relic-silver.flavorText: A silver coin used in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

relic-statue.name: Relic Statue
relic-statue.flavorText: A stone figure made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

relic-vase.name: Relic Vase
relic-vase.flavorText: A vase made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

repeat-ball.name: Repeat Ball
repeat-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 3× for previously-caught Pokémon.
repeat-ball.flavorText: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Pokémon species that were previously caught.

repel.name: Repel
repel.effect: For 100 steps, prevents wild encounters of level lower than your party’s lead Pokémon.
repel.flavorText: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 100 steps after its use.

reply-mail.name: Reply Mail
reply-mail.effect: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.
reply-mail.flavorText: Stationery designed for writing a reply. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

reset-urge.name: Reset Urge
reset-urge.effect: Resets a friendly Pokémon’s stat changes.
reset-urge.flavorText: When used, it restores any stat changes of an ally Pokémon.

resist-wing.name: Resist Feather
resist-wing.flavorText: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Defense stat of a single Pokémon.

revival-herb.name: Revival Herb
revival-herb.effect: Revives with full HP, but lowers happiness.
revival-herb.flavorText: A very bitter medicinal herb. It revives a fainted Pokémon, fully restoring its HP.

revive.name: Revive
revive.flavorText: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon. It restores half the Pokémon’s maximum HP.

rindo-berry.name: Rindo Berry
rindo-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Grass-type attack to halve the damage.
rindo-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Grass-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

ring-target.name: Ring Target
ring-target.effect: Held: Negates the holder’s type immunities. Ability immunities are not removed.
ring-target.flavorText: Moves that would otherwise have no effect will land on the Pokémon that holds it.

rock-gem.name: Rock Gem
rock-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Rock-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
rock-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of rock. When held, it strengthens the power of a Rock-type move only once.

rock-incense.name: Rock Incense
rock-incense.effect: Held: Rock-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Breeding: Sudowoodo begets a Bonsly Egg.
rock-incense.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

rocky-helmet.name: Rocky Helmet
rocky-helmet.effect: Held: When the holder is hit by a contact move, the attacking Pokémon takes 1/6 its max HP in damage.
rocky-helmet.flavorText: If the holder of this item takes damage, the attacker will also be damaged upon contact.

root-fossil.name: Root Fossil
root-fossil.effect: Can be revived into a Lileep.
root-fossil.flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It appears to be part of a plant root.

rose-incense.name: Rose Incense
rose-incense.effect: Held: Grass-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Breeding: Roselia or Roserade beget a Budew Egg.
rose-incense.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

rowap-berry.name: Rowap Berry
rowap-berry.effect: Held: Consumed to deal 1/8 attacker’s max HP when holder is struck by a special attack.
rowap-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon and a special attack lands, the attacker also takes damage.

rsvp-mail.name: RSVP Mail
rsvp-mail.effect: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.
rsvp-mail.flavorText: Stationery designed for invitations. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

rule-book.name: Rule Book
rule-book.effect: List of battle types and their rules.
rule-book.flavorText: It lists the rules for holding battles. For linked battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.

sacred-ash.name: Sacred Ash
sacred-ash.effect: Revives all fainted Pokémon with full HP.
sacred-ash.flavorText: It revives all fainted Pokémon. In doing so, it also fully restores their HP.

safari-ball.name: Safari Ball
safari-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon in the Great Marsh or Safari Zone. Success rate is 1.5×.
safari-ball.flavorText: A special Poké Ball that is used only in the Great Marsh. It is decorated in a camouflage pattern.

salac-berry.name: Salac Berry
salac-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/4 max HP to boost Speed.
salac-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Speed stat in a pinch.

scope-lens.name: Scope Lens
scope-lens.effect: Held: Raises the holder’s critical hit ratio by one stage.
scope-lens.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a lens that boosts the holder’s critical-hit ratio.

sea-incense.name: Sea Incense
sea-incense.effect: Held: Water-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Breeding: Marill or Azumarill beget an Azurill Egg.
sea-incense.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is incense with a curious aroma that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

seal-bag.name: Seal Bag
seal-bag.effect: Holds ten Seals for Poké Balls.
seal-bag.flavorText: A tiny bag that can hold ten Seals for decorating Poké Balls.

seal-case.name: Seal Case
seal-case.effect: Stores Seals that can be applied to Poké Ball capsules.
seal-case.flavorText: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the Capsule cases of Poké Balls.

secret-key.name: Secret Key
secret-key.effect: Gen IV: The key to Rotom’s appliance room. Gen III: The key to Cinnabar Gym.
secret-key.flavorText: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electric signal to open a door.

secret-potion.name: Secret Potion
secret-potion.effect: Used to heal the Ampharos at the top of Olivine Lighthouse.
secret-potion.flavorText: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.

sharp-beak.name: Sharp Beak
sharp-beak.effect: Held: Flying-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
sharp-beak.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a long, sharp beak that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.

shed-shell.name: Shed Shell
shed-shell.effect: Held: Holder can bypass all trapping effects and switch out. Multi-turn moves still cannot be switched out of.
shed-shell.flavorText: A tough, discarded carapace to be held by a Pokémon. It enables the holder to switch with a waiting Pokémon in battle.

shell-bell.name: Shell Bell
shell-bell.effect: Held: Holder receives 1/8 of the damage it deals when attacking.
shell-bell.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder’s HP is restored a little every time it inflicts damage.

shiny-stone.name: Shiny Stone
shiny-stone.effect: Evolves a Minccino into Cinccino, a Roselia into Roserade, or a Togetic into Togekiss.
shiny-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It shines with a dazzling light.

shoal-salt.name: Shoal Salt
shoal-salt.effect: No effect. Gen III: Trade four and four Shoal Shells for a Shell Bell.
shoal-salt.flavorText: Pure salt that can be discovered deep inside the Shoal Cave. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

shoal-shell.name: Shoal Shell
shoal-shell.effect: No effect. Gen III: Trade four and four Shoal Salts for a Shell Bell.
shoal-shell.flavorText: A pretty seashell that can be found deep inside the Shoal Cave. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

shock-drive.name: Shock Drive
shock-drive.effect: Grants Genesect a yellow, Electric-type Techno Blast.
shock-drive.flavorText: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Techno Blast to an Electric-type move.

shuca-berry.name: Shuca Berry
shuca-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Ground-type attack to halve the damage.
shuca-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Ground-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

silk-scarf.name: Silk Scarf
silk-scarf.effect: Held: Normal-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
silk-scarf.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of Normal-type moves.

silver-powder.name: Silver Powder
silver-powder.effect: Held: Bug-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
silver-powder.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a shiny, silver powder that ups the power of Bug-type moves.

silver-wing.name: Silver Wing
silver-wing.effect: Summons Lugia to the Whirl Islands.
silver-wing.flavorText: A strange, silvery feather that sparkles.

sitrus-berry.name: Sitrus Berry
sitrus-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to recover 1/4 max HP.
sitrus-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it heals the user’s HP a little.

skull-fossil.name: Skull Fossil
skull-fossil.effect: Can be revived into a Cranidos.
skull-fossil.flavorText: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that lived on the land. It appears to be part of a head.

sky-plate.name: Sky Plate
sky-plate.effect: Held: Flying-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Flying.
sky-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.

slowpoke-tail.name: Slowpoke Tail
slowpoke-tail.effect: A tasty tail that sells for a high price.
slowpoke-tail.flavorText: A very tasty tail of something. It sells for a high price.

smoke-ball.name: Smoke Ball
smoke-ball.effect: Held: Allows the Holder to escape from any wild battle.
smoke-ball.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It enables the holder to flee from any wild Pokémon without fail.

smooth-rock.name: Smooth Rock
smooth-rock.effect: Held: Sandstorm by the holder lasts 8 rounds instead of 5.
smooth-rock.flavorText: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Sandstorm used by the holder.

soda-pop.name: Soda Pop
soda-pop.flavorText: A fizzy soda drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 60 points.

soft-sand.name: Soft Sand
soft-sand.effect: Held: Ground-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
soft-sand.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a loose, silky sand that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.

soothe-bell.name: Soothe Bell
soothe-bell.effect: Held: Doubles the happiness earned by the holder.
soothe-bell.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bell with a comforting chime that calms the holder and makes it friendly.

soul-dew.name: Soul Dew
soul-dew.effect: Raises Latias and Latios’s Special Attack and Special Defense by 50%.
soul-dew.flavorText: A wondrous orb to be held by Latios or Latias. It raises both the Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

spell-tag.name: Spell Tag
spell-tag.effect: Held: Ghost-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
spell-tag.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sinister, eerie tag that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.

spelon-berry.name: Spelon Berry
spelon-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
spelon-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

splash-plate.name: Splash Plate
splash-plate.effect: Held: Water-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Water.
splash-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

spooky-plate.name: Spooky Plate
spooky-plate.effect: Held: Ghost-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Ghost.
spooky-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.

sport-ball.name: Sport Ball
sport-ball.effect: Tries to catch a Pokémon in the Bug-Catching contest in National Park. (Gen II: Park Ball)
sport-ball.flavorText: A special Poké Ball for the Bug-Catching Contest.

sprayduck.name: Sprayduck
sprayduck.flavorText: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote healthy growth of Berries planted in soft soil.

squirt-bottle.name: Squirt Bottle
squirt-bottle.effect: Use on Sudowoodo blocking the path on Route 36. Also waters berries.
squirt-bottle.flavorText: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.

ss-ticket.name: S.S. Ticket
ss-ticket.effect: Ticket for a ship. (RSE: S.S. Tidal LF: S.S. Anne HG: S.S. Aqua)
ss-ticket.flavorText: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

stable-mulch.name: Stable Mulch
stable-mulch.effect: Berries stay on the plant for longer than their usual time.
stable-mulch.flavorText: A fertilizer to be spread on soft soil in regions where Berries are grown. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

star-piece.name: Star Piece
star-piece.effect: Platinum: Trade for one of each color Shard. Black and White: Trade for PP Up. Sell for 4900 Pokédollars, or to Ore Collector for 9800 Pokédollars.
star-piece.flavorText: A shard of a pretty gem that sparkles in a red color. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

stardust.name: Stardust
stardust.effect: Sell for 1000 Pokédollars, or to Ore Collector for 2000 Pokédollars.
stardust.flavorText: Lovely, red-colored sand with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

starf-berry.name: Starf Berry
starf-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/4 max HP to boost a random stat by two stages.
starf-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it sharply raises one of its stats in a pinch.

steel-gem.name: Steel Gem
steel-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Steel-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
steel-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of steel. When held, it strengthens the power of a Steel-type move only once.

stick.name: Leek
stick.effect: Raises Farfetch’d’s critical hit ratio by two stages.
stick.flavorText: An item to be held by Farfetch’d. It is a very long and stiff stalk of leek that boosts the critical-hit ratio.

sticky-barb.name: Sticky Barb
sticky-barb.effect: Held: Holder takes 1/8 (12.5%) its max HP at the end of each turn. When the holder is hit by a contact move, the attacking Pokémon takes 1/8 its max HP in damage and receive the item if not holding one.
sticky-barb.flavorText: A held item that damages the holder on every turn. It may latch on to foes and allies that touch the holder.

stone-plate.name: Stone Plate
stone-plate.effect: Held: Rock-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Rock.
stone-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

storage-key.name: Storage Key
storage-key.effect: Grants access to the Team Galactic warehouse in Veilstone City.
storage-key.flavorText: The key to Team Galactic’s sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.

suite-key.name: Suite Key
suite-key.effect: Opens a locked building in the Lakeside Resort.
suite-key.flavorText: A key to one of the suites at the luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.

sun-stone.name: Sun Stone
sun-stone.effect: Evolves a Cottonee into Whimsicott, a Gloom into Bellossom, a Petilil into Lilligant, or a Sunkern into Sunflora.
sun-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as red as the sun.

super-potion.name: Super Potion
super-potion.flavorText: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

super-repel.name: Super Repel
super-repel.effect: For 200 steps, prevents wild encounters of level lower than your party’s lead Pokémon.
super-repel.flavorText: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 200 steps after its use.

super-rod.name: Super Rod
super-rod.effect: Used to catch Pokémon in bodies of water.
super-rod.flavorText: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

sweet-heart.name: Sweet Heart
sweet-heart.flavorText: Very sweet chocolate. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by only 20 points.

swift-wing.name: Swift Feather
swift-wing.flavorText: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Speed stat of a single Pokémon.

tamato-berry.name: Tamato Berry
tamato-berry.effect: Drops Speed Effort Values by 10 and raises happiness.
tamato-berry.flavorText: Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly, but it also lowers its base Speed stat.

tanga-berry.name: Tanga Berry
tanga-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Bug-type attack to halve the damage.
tanga-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Bug-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

thanks-mail.name: Thanks Mail
thanks-mail.effect: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.
thanks-mail.flavorText: Stationery designed for a thank-you note. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

thick-club.name: Thick Club
thick-club.flavorText: An item to be held by Cubone or Marowak. It is a hard bone of some sort that boosts the Attack stat.

thunder-stone.name: Thunder Stone
thunder-stone.effect: Evolves an Eelektrik into Eelektross, an Eevee into Jolteon, or a Pikachu into Raichu.
thunder-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a thunderbolt pattern.

tidal-bell.name: Tidal Bell
tidal-bell.flavorText: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing.

timer-ball.name: Timer Ball
timer-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate increases by 0.1× (Gen V: 0.3×) every turn, to a max of 4×.
timer-ball.flavorText: A somewhat different Ball that becomes progressively better the more turns there are in a battle.

tiny-mushroom.name: Tiny Mushroom
tiny-mushroom.effect: Fire Red and Leaf Green: Trade two for prior Level-up moves. Sell for 250 Pokédollars, or to Hungry Maid for 500 Pokédollars.
tiny-mushroom.flavorText: A small and rare mushroom. It is sought after by collectors.

tm01.name: TM01
tm01.effect: Teaches Hone Claws to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV & III: Focus Punch Gen II: DynamicPunch Gen I: Mega Punch)
tm01.flavorText: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

tm02.name: TM02
tm02.effect: Teaches Dragon Claw to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Headbutt Gen I: Razor Wind)
tm02.flavorText: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.

tm03.name: TM03
tm03.effect: Teaches Psyshock to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV & III: Water Pulse Gen II: Curse Gen I: Swords Dance)
tm03.flavorText: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

tm04.name: TM04
tm04.effect: Teaches Calm Mind to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Rollout Gen I: Whirlwind)
tm04.flavorText: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tm05.name: TM05
tm05.effect: Teaches Roar to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen I: Mega Kick)
tm05.flavorText: The target is scared off and replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

tm06.name: TM06
tm06.effect: Teaches Toxic to a compatible Pokémon.
tm06.flavorText: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

tm07.name: TM07
tm07.effect: Teaches Hail to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Zap Cannon Gen I: Horn Drill)
tm07.flavorText: Summons a hailstorm that lasts for five turns. The hailstorm damages all types except Ice.

tm08.name: TM08
tm08.effect: Teaches Bulk Up to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Rock Smash Gen I: Body Slam)
tm08.flavorText: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

tm09.name: TM09
tm09.effect: Teaches Venoshock to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV & III: Bullet Seed Gen II: Psych Up Gen I: Take Down)
tm09.flavorText: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. Its power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

tm10.name: TM10
tm10.effect: Teaches Hidden Power to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen I: Double-Edge)
tm10.flavorText: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

tm11.name: TM11
tm11.effect: Teaches Sunny Day to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen I: BubbleBeam)
tm11.flavorText: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

tm12.name: TM12
tm12.effect: Teaches Taunt to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Sweet Scent Gen I: Water Gun)
tm12.flavorText: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

tm13.name: TM13
tm13.effect: Teaches Ice Beam to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Snore)
tm13.flavorText: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

tm14.name: TM14
tm14.effect: Teaches Blizzard to a compatible Pokémon.
tm14.flavorText: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the opposing team. It may also freeze them solid.

tm15.name: TM15
tm15.effect: Teaches Hyper Beam to a compatible Pokémon.
tm15.flavorText: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

tm16.name: TM16
tm16.effect: Teaches Light Screen to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Icy Wind Gen I: Pay Day)
tm16.flavorText: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

tm17.name: TM17
tm17.effect: Teaches Protect to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen I: Submission)
tm17.flavorText: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tm18.name: TM18
tm18.effect: Teaches Rain Dance to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen I: Counter)
tm18.flavorText: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

tm19.name: TM19
tm19.effect: Teaches Telekinesis to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV & III & II: Giga Drain Gen I: Seismic Toss)
tm19.flavorText: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

tm20.name: TM20
tm20.effect: Teaches Safeguard to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Endure Gen I: Rage)
tm20.flavorText: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

tm21.name: TM21
tm21.effect: Teaches Frustration to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen I: Mega Drain)
tm21.flavorText: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

tm22.name: TM22
tm22.effect: Teaches SolarBeam to a compatible Pokémon.
tm22.flavorText: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

tm23.name: TM23
tm23.effect: Teaches Smack Down to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV & III & II: Iron Tail Gen I: Dragon Rage)
tm23.flavorText: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when it’s hit.

tm24.name: TM24
tm24.effect: Teaches Thunderbolt to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: DragonBreath)
tm24.flavorText: A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

tm25.name: TM25
tm25.effect: Teaches Thunder to a compatible Pokémon.
tm25.flavorText: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

tm26.name: TM26
tm26.effect: Teaches Earthquake to a compatible Pokémon.
tm26.flavorText: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

tm27.name: TM27
tm27.effect: Teaches Return to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen I: Fissure)
tm27.flavorText: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

tm28.name: TM28
tm28.effect: Teaches Dig to a compatible Pokémon.
tm28.flavorText: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

tm29.name: TM29
tm29.effect: Teaches Psychic to a compatible Pokémon.
tm29.flavorText: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tm30.name: TM30
tm30.effect: Teaches Shadow Ball to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen I: Teleport)
tm30.flavorText: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tm31.name: TM31
tm31.effect: Teaches Brick Break to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Mud-Slap Gen I: Mimic)
tm31.flavorText: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

tm32.name: TM32
tm32.effect: Teaches Double Team to a compatible Pokémon.
tm32.flavorText: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

tm33.name: TM33
tm33.effect: Teaches Reflect to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Ice Punch)
tm33.flavorText: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

tm34.name: TM34
tm34.effect: Teaches Sludge Wave to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV & III: Shock Wave Gen II: Swagger Gen I: Bide)
tm34.flavorText: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

tm35.name: TM35
tm35.effect: Teaches Flamethrower to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Sleep Talk Gen I: Metronome)
tm35.flavorText: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

tm36.name: TM36
tm36.effect: Teaches Sludge Bomb to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen I: Selfdestruct)
tm36.flavorText: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

tm37.name: TM37
tm37.effect: Teaches Sandstorm to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen I: Egg Bomb)
tm37.flavorText: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

tm38.name: TM38
tm38.effect: Teaches Fire Blast to a compatible Pokémon.
tm38.flavorText: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

tm39.name: TM39
tm39.effect: Teaches Rock Tomb to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II & I: Swift)
tm39.flavorText: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target’s Speed by preventing its movement.

tm40.name: TM40
tm40.effect: Teaches Aerial Ace to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Defense Curl Gen I: Skull Bash)
tm40.flavorText: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

tm41.name: TM41
tm41.effect: Teaches Torment to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: ThunderPunch Gen I: Softboiled)
tm41.flavorText: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

tm42.name: TM42
tm42.effect: Teaches Facade to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II & I: Dream Eater)
tm42.flavorText: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

tm43.name: TM43
tm43.effect: Teaches Flame Charge to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV & III: Secret Power Gen II: Detect Gen I: Sky Attack)
tm43.flavorText: The user cloaks itself with flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user’s Speed stat.

tm44.name: TM44
tm44.effect: Teaches Rest to a compatible Pokémon.
tm44.flavorText: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

tm45.name: TM45
tm45.effect: Teaches Attract to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen I: Thunder Wave)
tm45.flavorText: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

tm46.name: TM46
tm46.effect: Teaches Thief to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen I: Psywave)
tm46.flavorText: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

tm47.name: TM47
tm47.effect: Teaches Low Sweep to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV & III & II: Steel Wing Gen I: Explosion)
tm47.flavorText: The user attacks the target’s legs swiftly, reducing the target’s Speed stat.

tm48.name: TM48
tm48.effect: Teaches Round to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV & III: Skill Swap Gen II: Fire Punch Gen I: Rock Slide)
tm48.flavorText: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.

tm49.name: TM49
tm49.effect: Teaches Echoed Voice to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV & III: Snatch Gen II: Fury Cutter Gen I: Tri Attack)
tm49.flavorText: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

tm50.name: TM50
tm50.effect: Teaches Overheat to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen II: Nightmare Gen I: Substitute)
tm50.flavorText: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tm51.name: TM51
tm51.effect: Teaches Ally Switch to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Roost)
tm51.flavorText: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.

tm52.name: TM52
tm52.effect: Teaches Focus Blast to a compatible Pokémon.
tm52.flavorText: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

tm53.name: TM53
tm53.effect: Teaches Energy Ball to a compatible Pokémon.
tm53.flavorText: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

tm54.name: TM54
tm54.effect: Teaches False Swipe to a compatible Pokémon.
tm54.flavorText: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

tm55.name: TM55
tm55.effect: Teaches Scald to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Brine)
tm55.flavorText: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

tm56.name: TM56
tm56.effect: Teaches Fling to a compatible Pokémon.
tm56.flavorText: The user flings its held item at the target as an attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

tm57.name: TM57
tm57.effect: Teaches Charge Beam to a compatible Pokémon.
tm57.flavorText: The user attacks with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

tm58.name: TM58
tm58.effect: Teaches Sky Drop to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Endure)
tm58.flavorText: The user hurls the target into the air, then drops it on the second turn. The target cannot attack while in the air.

tm59.name: TM59
tm59.effect: Teaches Incinerate to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Dragon Pulse)
tm59.flavorText: The user attacks the target with fire. If the target is holding a Berry, the Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

tm60.name: TM60
tm60.effect: Teaches Quash to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Drain Punch)
tm60.flavorText: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

tm61.name: TM61
tm61.effect: Teaches Will-O-Wisp to a compatible Pokémon.
tm61.flavorText: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.

tm62.name: TM62
tm62.effect: Teaches Acrobatics to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Silver Wind)
tm62.flavorText: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.

tm63.name: TM63
tm63.effect: Teaches Embargo to a compatible Pokémon.
tm63.flavorText: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

tm64.name: TM64
tm64.effect: Teaches Explosion to a compatible Pokémon.
tm64.flavorText: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.

tm65.name: TM65
tm65.effect: Teaches Shadow Claw to a compatible Pokémon.
tm65.flavorText: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tm66.name: TM66
tm66.effect: Teaches Payback to a compatible Pokémon.
tm66.flavorText: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user can use this attack after the target, its power is doubled.

tm67.name: TM67
tm67.effect: Teaches Retaliate to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Recycle)
tm67.flavorText: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this attack’s damage increases.

tm68.name: TM68
tm68.effect: Teaches Giga Impact to a compatible Pokémon.
tm68.flavorText: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

tm69.name: TM69
tm69.effect: Teaches Rock Polish to a compatible Pokémon.
tm69.flavorText: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It sharply raises the Speed stat.

tm70.name: TM70
tm70.effect: Teaches Flash to a compatible Pokémon.
tm70.flavorText: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

tm71.name: TM71
tm71.effect: Teaches Stone Edge to a compatible Pokémon.
tm71.flavorText: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tm72.name: TM72
tm72.effect: Teaches Volt Switch to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Avalanche)
tm72.flavorText: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

tm73.name: TM73
tm73.effect: Teaches Thunder Wave to a compatible Pokémon.
tm73.flavorText: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

tm74.name: TM74
tm74.effect: Teaches Gyro Ball to a compatible Pokémon.
tm74.flavorText: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

tm75.name: TM75
tm75.effect: Teaches Swords Dance to a compatible Pokémon.
tm75.flavorText: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

tm76.name: TM76
tm76.effect: Teaches Struggle Bug to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Stealth Rock)
tm76.flavorText: Resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets’ Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

tm77.name: TM77
tm77.effect: Teaches Psych Up to a compatible Pokémon.
tm77.flavorText: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

tm78.name: TM78
tm78.effect: Teaches Bulldoze to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Captivate)
tm78.flavorText: The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. The targets’ Speed stat is reduced.

tm79.name: TM79
tm79.effect: Teaches Frost Breath to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Dark Pulse)
tm79.flavorText: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

tm80.name: TM80
tm80.effect: Teaches Rock Slide to a compatible Pokémon.
tm80.flavorText: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing team to inflict damage. They may also make the targets flinch.

tm81.name: TM81
tm81.effect: Teaches X-Scissor to a compatible Pokémon.
tm81.flavorText: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

tm82.name: TM82
tm82.effect: Teaches Dragon Tail to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Sleep Talk)
tm82.flavorText: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

tm83.name: TM83
tm83.effect: Teaches Work Up to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV: Natural Gift)
tm83.flavorText: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

tm84.name: TM84
tm84.effect: Teaches Poison Jab to a compatible Pokémon.
tm84.flavorText: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the target.

tm85.name: TM85
tm85.effect: Teaches Dream Eater to a compatible Pokémon.
tm85.flavorText: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

tm86.name: TM86
tm86.effect: Teaches Grass Knot to a compatible Pokémon.
tm86.flavorText: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the damage.

tm87.name: TM87
tm87.effect: Teaches Swagger to a compatible Pokémon.
tm87.flavorText: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.

tm88.name: TM88
tm88.effect: Teaches Pluck to a compatible Pokémon.
tm88.flavorText: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

tm89.name: TM89
tm89.effect: Teaches U-turn to a compatible Pokémon.
tm89.flavorText: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

tm90.name: TM90
tm90.effect: Teaches Substitute to a compatible Pokémon.
tm90.flavorText: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

tm91.name: TM91
tm91.effect: Teaches Flash Cannon to a compatible Pokémon.
tm91.flavorText: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tm92.name: TM92
tm92.effect: Teaches Trick Room to a compatible Pokémon.
tm92.flavorText: The user creates a bizarre space in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

tm93.name: TM93
tm93.effect: Teaches Wild Charge to a compatible Pokémon.
tm93.flavorText: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. It also damages the user a little.

tm94.name: TM94
tm94.effect: Teaches Rock Smash to a compatible Pokémon.
tm94.flavorText: The user attacks with a punch that can shatter a rock. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tm95.name: TM95
tm95.effect: Teaches Snarl to a compatible Pokémon.
tm95.flavorText: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target’s Sp. Atk stat decrease.

town-map.name: Town Map
town-map.effect: Use to see the overworld map.
town-map.flavorText: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

toxic-orb.name: Toxic Orb
toxic-orb.effect: Held: Inflicts Toxic on the holder at the end of the turn. Activates after Poison damage would occur.
toxic-orb.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that badly poisons the holder in battle.

toxic-plate.name: Toxic Plate
toxic-plate.effect: Held: Poison-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Poison.
toxic-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Poison-type moves.

twisted-spoon.name: Twisted Spoon
twisted-spoon.effect: Held: Psychic-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
twisted-spoon.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a spoon imbued with telekinetic power that boosts Psychic-type moves.

ultra-ball.name: Ultra Ball
ultra-ball.effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 2×.
ultra-ball.flavorText: An ultra-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a Great Ball.

unown-report.name: Unown Report
unown-report.effect: Keeps track of Unown types caught.
unown-report.flavorText: A report of all the discovered kinds of Unown.

up-grade.name: Upgrade
up-grade.effect: Traded on a Porygon: Holder evolves into Porygon2.
up-grade.flavorText: A transparent device filled with all sorts of data. It was produced by Silph Co.

vs-recorder.name: Vs. Recorder
vs-recorder.effect: Records wireless, Wi-Fi, or Battle Frontier battles, and stores points.
vs-recorder.flavorText: An amazing device that can record a battle either between friends or at a special battle facility.

vs-seeker.name: Vs. Seeker
vs-seeker.effect: Allows rebattling of on-screen trainers. 100 steps to recharge.
vs-seeker.flavorText: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.

wacan-berry.name: Wacan Berry
wacan-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Electric-type attack to halve the damage.
wacan-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Electric-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

water-gem.name: Water Gem
water-gem.effect: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Water-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.
water-gem.flavorText: A gem with an essence of water. When held, it strengthens the power of a Water-type move only once.

water-stone.name: Water Stone
water-stone.effect: Evolves an Eevee into Vaporeon, a Lombre into Ludicolo, a Panpour into Simipour, a Poliwhirl into Poliwrath, a Shellder into Cloyster, or a Staryu into Starmie.
water-stone.flavorText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is a clear, light blue.

watmel-berry.name: Watmel Berry
watmel-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
watmel-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

wave-incense.name: Wave Incense
wave-incense.effect: Held: Water-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Breeding: Mantine begets a Mantyke Egg.
wave-incense.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is incense with a curious aroma that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

wepear-berry.name: Wepear Berry
wepear-berry.effect: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.
wepear-berry.flavorText: A Berry which is very rare in the Unova region. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

white-apricorn.name: White Apricorn
white-apricorn.effect: Used to make a Fast Ball.
white-apricorn.flavorText: A white Apricorn. It doesn’t smell like anything.

white-flute.name: White Flute
white-flute.effect: Doubles the wild Pokémon encounter rate.
white-flute.flavorText: A toy flute made from white glass. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

white-herb.name: White Herb
white-herb.effect: Held: Resets all lowered stats to normal at end of turn. Consumed after use.
white-herb.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It restores any lowered stat in battle. It can be used only once.

wide-lens.name: Wide Lens
wide-lens.effect: Held: Provides a 1/10 (10%) boost in accuracy to the holder.
wide-lens.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the accuracy of moves.

wiki-berry.name: Wiki Berry
wiki-berry.effect: Held: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to restore 1/8 max HP. Confuses Pokémon that dislike dry flavor.
wiki-berry.flavorText: If held by a Pokémon, it restores the user’s HP in a pinch, but will cause confusion if it hates the taste.

wise-glasses.name: Wise Glasses
wise-glasses.effect: Held: Boosts the damage of special moves used by the holder by 1/10 (10%).
wise-glasses.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a thick pair of glasses that slightly boosts the power of special moves.

works-key.name: Works Key
works-key.flavorText: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.

x-accuracy.name: X Accuracy
x-accuracy.effect: Raises accuracy by one stage in battle. Raises happiness.
x-accuracy.flavorText: An item that raises the accuracy of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

x-accuracy-2.name: X Accuracy 2
x-accuracy-2.effect: Raises accuracy by two stages in battle. Wonder Launcher only.
x-accuracy-2.flavorText: It sharply raises the accuracy of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

x-sp-atk-6.flavorText: It raises the Sp. Atk stat of a Pokémon in battle immensely. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

xtransceiver.name: Xtransceiver
xtransceiver.flavorText: A high-tech transceiver with a camera function. It allows up to four-way calls.

yache-berry.name: Yache Berry
yache-berry.effect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Ice-type attack to halve the damage.
yache-berry.flavorText: Weakens a supereffective Ice-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

yellow-apricorn.name: Yellow Apricorn
yellow-apricorn.effect: Used to make a Moon Ball.
yellow-apricorn.flavorText: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.

yellow-flute.name: Yellow Flute
yellow-flute.flavorText: A toy flute made from yellow glass. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

yellow-scarf.name: Yellow Scarf
yellow-scarf.effect: Raises the holder’s Toughness while in a contest.
yellow-scarf.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the Tough aspect of the holder in a Contest.

yellow-shard.name: Yellow Shard
yellow-shard.effect: No effect. Can be traded for items or moves.
yellow-shard.flavorText: A small yellow shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.

zap-plate.name: Zap Plate
zap-plate.effect: Held: Electric-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Electric.
zap-plate.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.

zinc.name: Zinc
zinc.flavorText: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Sp. Def (Special Defense) stat of a single Pokémon.

zoom-lens.name: Zoom Lens
zoom-lens.effect: Held: Provides a 1/5 (20%) boost in accuracy if the holder moves after the target.
zoom-lens.flavorText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder moves after its target, its accuracy will be boosted.
